name: Burg - Scharnitz
kurzbeschreibung:
**Burg Scharnitz** – a medieval fortress nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alpen**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Perched atop a dramatic cliff, this 13th-century stronghold offers breathtaking views over the **Inn Valley** and the rugged peaks of the **Kaisergebirge**.

Explore the well-preserved ruins, wander through the **Burgmuseum**, and soak in the rich history of the **Tiroler** knights who once defended these lands. The fortress is easily accessible via a scenic cable car from **Scharnitz**, making it a perfect stop for history lovers and hikers alike.

After your visit, indulge in a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** or a bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl** at one of the nearby mountain huts—ideal for refueling before or after your adventure. Whether you're seeking culture, panoramic vistas, or a taste of **Tiroler** hospitality, **Burg Scharnitz** delivers an unforgettable experience.
